lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of large, high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a primary horizontal row along the mid-flank, with secondary rows of smaller clusters positioned dorsally and ventrally to the primary axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal bands to form a grid-like structure, with the most intense luminance nodes located at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from light upper edges to shadowed lower edges, running parallel to the long axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of small, high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more randomly distributed than the larger blobs on the lateral flank.
